[hr][/hr]
Update 1.1.0 Patch Notes

New timing system and Leaderboard reset
This update introduces a new timing system with 3 decimal places. The previous system was unprecise and caused a lot of similar times to show up in the top 10 leaderboards.
Unfortunately, due to this change, we had to reset the public leaderboards and also remove local records and medal times.

The old version with the old timing system is now available as a beta so you can still view your previous leaderboard times or check your medals.
To access the old version, go to your Steam Library, right click Vacuum Pilot, go to "Betas" and select "legacy".

The legacy version cannot run workshop levels or access online features like multiplayer or leaderboard upload.

Additional changes

Performance improvements
Bug fixes
Localization improvements

During the Steam Winter Sale, all of our cosmetics are heavily discounted. Check out our Item Store and give your ship a unique look! This offer ends January 5th!

notes.title: Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
Hey there!

After a long year, Vacuum Pilot is leaving Early Access.

We have made a lot of progress during Early Access, including improved graphics, improved mouse responsiveness, online ghosts, overhauled customization options, improved User Interfaces and most importantly: A ton of bug fixes to improve the player experience.

Leaving Early Access does not mean that we are done with developing the game!
We do however think that the game is now polished enough and features enough content to be considered a full game.

We will continue to work on new levels, game modes, bug fixes and other improvements to the game!

notes.title: Vacuum Pilot is now Free to Play
notes.content:
Add the game to your library now and start drifting around corners and climbing the leaderboards in this unique mouse movement based speedrunning racer!

Key Features:

Enjoy over 30 official levels (more to come)
Global Leaderboards
Earn medals to unlock new customization options
Casual and competitive real-time multiplayer
Watch replays of other players and compete with their ghost
Level Editor and Steam Workshop support



For more information, check out this short FAQ we have made:
[hr][/hr] 
Why Free to Play?
A competitive game like Vacuum Pilot needs a healthy amount of active users to populate the leaderboards and online lobbies.
With our current business model, we did not reach enough users. Lobbies were empty and the leaderboards did not change often.
By going Free to Play, we hope to increase user activity and end up with an actual competitive environment.
Additionally, going free to play means more potential feedback to improve our game during Early Access!
[hr][/hr] 
Will there be "pay to win"?
No. The current plan is to only allow the purchase of visual elements, like new ships or ship parts.
They do not and will not change the behaviour of the ship.
[hr][/hr] 
Are there any bonuses for people that have already bought Vacuum Pilot?
Yes. People that have bought Vacuum Pilot before September 23rd will receive every single microtransaction that will ever be in the game for free.
[hr][/hr] 
If you want to give us feedback, feel free to join our Discord Server or create a discussion in the Vacuum Pilot Community Hub.

Thanks for playing, we can't wait to see your records!

notes.title: Vacuum Pilot goes Free to Play + Season 2 preview
notes.content:
Hey there!

The Season 2 update will go live on September 23rd and will feature new Levels, entirely new customizable ships and new features!
But before we go into more Season 2 details, we are happy to announce that
Vacuum Pilot goes Free to Play
That's right! Starting with Season 2 on September 23rd, Vacuum Pilot will be available for free, forever!
[hr][/hr] 
Why Free to Play?
A competitive game like Vacuum Pilot needs a healthy amount of active users to populate the leaderboards and online lobbies.
With our current business model, we did not reach enough users. Lobbies were empty and the leaderboards did not change often.
By going Free to Play, we hope to increase user activity and end up with an actual competitive environment.
Additionally, going free to play means more potential feedback to improve our game during Early Access!
[hr][/hr] 
Will there be "pay to win"?
No. The current plan is to only allow the purchase of visual elements, like new ships or ship parts.
They do not and will not change the behaviour of the ship.
[hr][/hr] 
Are there any bonuses for people that have already bought Vacuum Pilot?
Yes. People that have bought or will buy Vacuum Pilot before September 23rd will receive every single microtransaction that will ever be in the game for free.
[hr][/hr] 
Season 2
New Levels
Season 2 will introduce 10 new cave and jungle themed levels, with more to come in future updates.

Here's a preview
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/25e42bce67b66affdc9c4a1c742a7ab6ff01fa1f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/121337620b63e8c16054eaeece000697742c7d54.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/e2d4bd5b1d2222c9f25b88539809c0d3703be5fe.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/ae95a2365aedd14248f4324d76e94c7a8ca1160c.png
[hr][/hr] 
New Ships
Season 2 will introduce entirely new ships with their own unique customization options.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/09badfaed93585912237112f66e1aa2d67d9e5c9.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/902192f0802115b0aa6b61efefa32f6cc66dc3bd.png
Users that have bought Vacuum Pilot before September 23rd will be able to use the new ships with no additional costs! Free to play users will be able to purchase each ship for $1.99.

[hr][/hr] 
New Ghost and Replay System
Until now, the game would download and display every ghost of the currently selected leaderboard.
This made it impossible to actually compete against a specific ghost, and filled the screen with a lot of ghosts, making it harder to see and focus on the level.

For Season 2, we have rebuilt the ghost system from the ground up. It's now possible to download and compete against specific ghosts, and additionally you can also watch downloaded ghosts as a replay.

The eye symbol indicates if a ghost is downloaded and displayed. Click it to toggle the visibility of the corresponding ghost.  The "Replay" symbol can be clicked to watch the downloaded ghost as a replay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/e62392ea58fc5987f96faec4d6289a44c6ebe1d4.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/346ec78c1dfb6d8755b69c86e2b40f27eb58278a.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/204791178c2c96cc97df477e72959b5e6766cdfa.png
[hr][/hr] 
Season 2 also includes a ton of smaller quality of life changes and bug fixes! We will go into more detail once the official Patch Notes drop!
We hope you are looking forward to Season 2 and we can't wait to see what you think!
[hr][/hr]
Send us your feedback and suggestions!

The best way to reach and talk to us is through our Discord Server. Here, we will create polls based on the suggestions we receive so our player base can actively take part in the direction our development is taking.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Update 0.5.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there!

Update 0.5.0 is finally out and introduces a lot of improvements and new features!

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our Discord Server to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!

Thanks for playing!

--

Patch Notes

New Background Colors
We gave the game a more colorful look by reworking every single level and adding background colors!
Here is a comparison of "Industrial Zone" before and after the change!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/17d73bb30c8106262260e782659d649e101b1e4c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/8f4dfe578e96dfaeba63d9c56d7eca1861b1997b.png

Online leaderboard ghosts
You can now see the ghosts of other players while playing in Free Mode!
This way, you can directly compete with other players and see how they achieved their records!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/a301a6e6875b1ced38a222577e835b26c6e47483.gif

Arcade Mode Leaderboards
Arcade scores are now posted in a leaderboard and the Top 10 scores are publicly visible. We will add an option to compare your score to friends and rivals in a future update!

Mouse controls improvements

We have fixed a bug which caused mouse movements to be delayed on some system configurations. 
The mouse is now locked to the game window during a race. This is especially helpful for users with multiple screens.

Main menu overhaul
We gave the main menu a modernized look by moving the main menu buttons to the top and bottom of the screen.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/6f0e72d82e77b7d0769eeae665ac79edab7c8e17.png

Settings menu overhaul
We have also improved the Settings menu and placed every available option in a corresponding category. This should make it easier to find the option you are looking for.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/32288d4771cecde352093c6dac67250aa35b37ff.png

Improved Lighting and performance
We have fixed a problem which caused the lighting to look pixelated while the camera was moving. 
In some circumstances, lighting also caused a high GPU usage and frame stuttering.
These issues are now fixed.

Leaderboard reset
Due to changes to the leaderboards, all local records and ghosts were deleted and all leaderboard entries were removed. Your XP, Player Level and Ship customization are NOT affected!

--

Level Editor: Improved lighting color selection
Previously, when changing the color of a light source, you were limited to a set of pre-defined colors to choose from. This update introduces a color mixer which will allow you to choose every color possible.

Previous color selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/105bfb5d91efa3bb8ae8da1167b3277675f244ef.png
New color selection
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/af541736ae6500468d41d81021447a5436dfc5c5.png


---

notes.title: What's Next for Vacuum Pilot?
notes.content:
Vacuum Pilot has been out in Early Access for over a month now. We are far from done and have worked on improvements and a big new feature. While we can't announce a date yet, we want to share what's coming soon with Patch 0.5.0! 

New Feature

Online leaderboard ghosts
Starting with update 0.5.0, every entry in the leaderboard will have a ghost attached to it. The game will automatically download and display the ghosts of the current leaderboard. This way, you can directly compete with people on the leaderboard and see how they achieved their records!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/152ca2a386427addfa4bbd9476f3f1adfc471ece.gif

Improvements

Main menu overhaul
We are giving the main menu a modernized look by moving the main menu buttons to the top and bottom of the screen.
This also gives us more space to display news, patch notes and additional information.

Work in Progress screenshot of the start page
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/cb4613f7bd305884ebf3a020f8fba22a9d5578dd.png

Settings menu overhaul
We have also improved the Settings menu and placed every available option in a corresponding category. This should make it easier to find the option you are looking for.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/e005b82698373d33144a7e237802e1a35ddfd7e7.png

Lighting
We have identified a problem which caused the lighting to look pixelated while the camera was moving. 
In some circumstances, lighting could also cause a high GPU usage and frame stuttering.
These issues will be fixed with the upcoming update.

Current lighting (in motion): 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/4b2ce041f2d7e6e29349025fbe6aa50d6d2862e5.png
Update 0.5.0:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/0dcd15325bcf95b1f41d6cbeb35bb4f48c5e09ea.png


Level Editor: improved lighting color selection
Currently, when changing the color of a light source, you are limited to a set of pre-defined colors to choose from. With update 0.5.0, we will add a color mixer which will allow you to choose every color possible.

Current color selection:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/105bfb5d91efa3bb8ae8da1167b3277675f244ef.png
Update 0.5.0:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40843601/af541736ae6500468d41d81021447a5436dfc5c5.png

We hope you are looking forward to the changes that update 0.5.0 will introduce!
-----------------------------------

notes.title: Update 0.4.1a Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey there! After the launch of Early Access, we have received important feedback about usability and how to improve the experience for new players who are still learning the game. This small patch will focus on exactly that.

Before we begin with the patch notes, i would like to ask you to join our Discord Server to take active part in our game development! Every suggestion and feedback is appreciated!
If you would like to see the game in your language and want to help with the translations, you can message us on Discord!

Thanks for playing!

--

Game changes

Easier Bronze/Silver medal times
We have received feedback that earning the bronze medal was too hard for new players, which is why we have adjusted the time required to earn bronze and silver medals. Please let us know if the difficulty is good now, or if further adjustement is needed!

Level requirements for Arcade and Competitive mode
Some users started with Arcade mode right away and were confused at the lack of tutorials and the difficulty. To prevent this, we have decided to lock those modes for new players and unlock them after the player reaches Level 3.

notes.title: Vacuum Pilot Early Access Out Now!
notes.content:
Hey there! After a year in development, Vacuum Pilot is ready to launch into Early Access! We are looking forward to receive your feedback and suggestions!

The best way to reach and talk to us is through our Discord Server. Here, we will create polls based on the suggestions we receive so our player base can actively take part in the direction our development is taking.

Alternatively, head to the Steam Community-Hub of Vacuum Pilot and post your feedback there!

If you would like to see the game in your language and want to help with the translations, message us on Discord!

25 Levels
Global leaderboards for all levels
Online Multiplayer (Casual and Competitive)
Level and XP System
Ship Customization
Level Editor
Steam Workshop Support


We hope you have as much fun playing the game as we have making it!
